title: Órdenes, ruegos y peticiones referidas: del imperativo al subjuntivo
goal: Report direct commands, requests, and prohibitions by shifting imperatives to the imperfect subjunctive.
grammar: estilo indirecto de mandatos y peticiones con verbo en pasado y pretérito imperfecto de subjuntivo

items: Transform imperative commands into subordinate clauses with the imperfect subjunctive.
Differentiate between reporting information (indicative) and reporting commands (subjunctive).
Formulate formal institutional directives and legal injunctions in reported speech.
